purpose: Replace rejected reused wall panels with a dedicated, legible Compact mooring in the Gullet coil.
generator: built-in image_gen; Meshy T2 via guarded bridge
boardPrompt: Create a polished game prop design board for CORONACH, an HD-2D toon science-fantasy action RPG. Landscape canvas with two clearly separated panels: left 70 percent shows one large clean three-quarter perspective reference of a COMPACT CHOIR MOORING; right 30 percent shows a small contextual inset of four such moorings sunk into the violet organic floor of a giant living tunnel, restraining a sleek dark route serpent with thin amber energy tethers. The prop must look like a specific industrial restraint, not a platform or room: very squat wide hexagonal cast-alloy shoe with rounded chamfered edges and four huge visible embedded bolts, two low triangular buttresses holding a recessed transverse winch drum, a forward horseshoe-shaped receiver clevis with thick curved metal jaws, a single bright amber warning band on the drum, dark gunmetal cavities, weathered pale grey ceramic armour with muted ochre edges, tiny cyan status light. Width about three times height, broad chunky forms that read from a 48-degree overhead gameplay camera. The clevis opens toward the viewer; a short cable socket at front, no long trailing cables on isolated reference. Slightly asymmetrical functional details, spare high-quality silhouette; not repeated floor panels, not a crate, not a spaceship, no spikes. Keep the main prop isolated against plain warm grey background, fully inside frame, three-dimensional with readable side/top surfaces, clean flat toon shading, soft hand-painted colour gradients, restrained texture wear, no photorealism, no labels or lettering. Context inset has deep folded indigo-violet tissue with warm lavender ridges, no gore, no honeycomb pattern. This is a design board before creating the final 3D reference.
referencePrompt: Use the large mooring prop on the left of this design board as the design reference. Produce exactly ONE isolated complete mooring prop, a single three-quarter front view from about 40 degrees above, centered at 80 percent canvas with generous margins on every side. Remove the contextual inset entirely. OPAQUE pure white background, no ground or shadow. Preserve the chunky hexagonal mounting shoe, four giant bolts, two triangular buttresses, central black transverse winch drum with one muted amber band, forward open horseshoe receiver jaws, one forward socket and tiny cyan status light. All details physically attached; no separate objects or trailing cables. Very squat and broad silhouette, width about three times height. Clean HD-2D cel shaded game prop with broad matte local-colour regions, pale grey ceramic metal armour, gunmetal cavities and restrained ochre edges. Simplify tiny scratches and texture noise into a few large wear marks. No baked lighting, gloss, reflections, ambient occlusion, rim light, bloom, cast shadows, text, labels, scenery or gradients in the white background. This isolated reference will be reconstructed as a real 3D game prop; show both the top and sides clearly without distortion.

referenceReview.findings: Single complete connected prop on opaque white, readable winch, receiver jaws, bolted shoe and restrained status light. No inset or text in the isolated reference. The contextual serpent is a concept, not a replacement for Cantor. Final mesh/render acceptance remains pending.
